findings.description: The separator conditional was inverted when moved into get_help_spec. The original code used "; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "; the new code uses "; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / ".
findings.rationale: Trigger: an option with both primary and secondary opts, such as --shout/--no-shout. Normally any_prefix_is_slash is False, so the old code joined with " / " but the new code joins with "; ". Help output changes from "--shout / --no-shout" to "--shout; --no-shout". For slash-prefixed opts like /debug;/no-debug the separator is also flipped.
